quark.config.creatures.name: Creatures
quark.config.creatures.wolf_targets_skel: Wolves consider skeleton horses valid prey.
quark.config.creatures.villagers_seek_wa: Burning villagers try to reach nearby water.
quark.config.creatures.endermen_avoid_wa: Endermen standing in water-filled cauldrons take damage and teleport.
quark.config.creatures.endermen_escape_b: Endermen riding boats or minecarts teleport away.
quark.config.creatures.hostile_mobs_cann: Hostile mobs dismount from boats and minecarts.
quark.config.creatures.passive_mobs_cann: Passive animals dismount from boats and minecarts.
quark.config.creatures.villagers_explode: Villagers attempting to sleep in the Nether or End explode.
quark.config.creatures.fearless_cats.des: Some naturally spawned cats no longer flee from players.
quark.config.creatures.fearless_cats.cha: Chance for a newly spawned cat to be fearless.
quark.config.world.name: World
quark.config.world.overlapping_nether_po: Lighting a frame that overlaps an existing portal can create a second portal.
quark.config.world.contained_end_portals: End portal blocks are generated strictly inside the 3x3 frame.
quark.config.world.nether_cauldrons_stay: Water cannot be placed into cauldrons in the Nether.
quark.config.world.powder_snow_cauldrons: Standing inside a powder snow cauldron causes freezing damage.
quark.config.world.falling_blocks_break_: Falling gravity blocks break big dripleaves and keep falling.
Falling gravity blocks crush turtle eggs.

quark.config.gameplay.leash_any_mob.name: Leash Any Mob
quark.config.gameplay.leash_any_mob.desc: Leashes can attach to any mob in survival mode.
quark.config.gameplay.void_totem.name: Void Totem
quark.config.gameplay.void_totem.desc: Held totems of undying save you from the void and teleport you upward.
quark.config.gameplay.guaranteed_zombie_: Zombies always convert villagers below Hard difficulty.
quark.config.gameplay.mine_from_boats.de: Mining while in a boat is as fast as mining on foot.
quark.config.gameplay.rainbow_wool.name: Rainbow Wool
quark.config.gameplay.rainbow_wool.desc: Shearing a jeb_ sheep drops wool that cycles through every color.
